title: Judgment on Babylon

questions.question: The oracle concerning Babylon which whom saw?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 13:1 (ESV): "The oracle concerning Babylon which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw."

questions.question: On a bare hill raise a what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 13:2 (ESV): "On a bare hill raise a signal;"

questions.question: I have commanded my consecrated ones; I have summoned my mighty men to execute my what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 13:3 (ESV): "summoned my mighty men to execute my anger,"

questions.question: Wail, for the day of the LORD is what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 13:6 (ESV): "Wail, for the day of the LORD is near;"

questions.question: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the splendor and pride of the Chaldeans, will be like what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 13:19 (ESV): "will be like Sodom and Gomorrah when God overthrew them."

questions.question: The sound of a tumult is on the mountains as of a great what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 13:4 (ESV): "The sound of a tumult is on the mountains as of a great multitude!"

questions.question: They come from a distant land, from the end of the heavens, the LORD and the weapons of his what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 13:5 (ESV): "the LORD and the weapons of his indignation,"

questions.question: Every heart will melt, and every hand will be what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 13:7 (ESV): "Therefore all hands will be feeble, and every human heart will melt."

questions.question: Behold, the day of the LORD comes, cruel, with wrath and fierce anger, to make the land a what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 13:9 (ESV): "to make the land a desolation"

questions.question: I will punish the world for its evil, and the wicked for their what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 13:11 (ESV): "and the wicked for their iniquity;"

questions.question: I will make people more rare than fine gold, and mankind than the gold of where?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 13:12 (ESV): "and mankind than the gold of Ophir."

questions.question: Therefore I will make the heavens tremble, and the earth will be shaken out of its what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 13:13 (ESV): "and the earth will be shaken out of its place,"

questions.question: Like a hunted gazelle or like sheep with none to gather them, each will turn to his own what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 13:14 (ESV): "each will turn to his own people,"

questions.question: Behold, I am stirring up who against them, who have no regard for silver and do not delight in gold?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 13:17 (ESV): "Behold, I am stirring up the Medes against them,"

questions.question: Wild beasts will lie down there, and their houses will be full of howling creatures; there ostriches will dwell, and there who will dance?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 13:21 (ESV): "and there wild goats will dance."

key_verse_text: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the splendor and pride of the Chaldeans, will be like Sodom and Gomorrah when God overthrew them.
